task.text: Inspect the model-construction code and implement reusable clothing/textile assets, fitting, manipulation, retained-scene integration, validation, and an external-verifier-compatible export.

active_decisions.summary: The machine-readable registry is the durable authority for current cross-session direction.
Repeated sessions must converge and material changes must preserve, supersede, reject, or mark unresolved canonical entries.
Meaningful visual generation defaults to a retained structured scene/model before rendering.
Useful discoveries must change real implementation and startup inheritance, then be verified.
Body, garments/artifacts, interactions, provenance, and conflicting hypotheses remain separate reusable layers.
Controlled implementation sessions initialize through Command Center and retain a receipt.

unresolved_decisions.summary: Internal role and record ownership among AI Core, BrightEngine, Forge, and Kairos remains unresolved; this task does not resolve it.

capabilities.summary: Turn reusable discoveries into applicable, implemented, validated, inherited capability changes.
Completion claims require recipient-path testing and clear evidence boundaries.
Keep body, garments, interaction, provenance, and competing reconstructions separate and reusable.

execution_gate.condition: The three authoritative registries were read from main via the connected GitHub repository tool; the registered adapter and applicable capabilities were resolved. Exact file SHA-256 values remain unavailable in connector mode, so Git blob IDs are retained as integrity references.
